mapper.select: select #{entity.workId} as work_id, channel_id, client_id, max(create_time) as meta_date_create_time, count(*) as data_size, #{entity.dataType} as data_type, #{entity.tid} as tid from ays_meta_data_analysis where to_date(create_time) = #{todayTime} and channel_id = #{entity.channelId} and client_id = #{entity.clientId} group by to_date(create_time), channel_id, client_id limit 1
